about: 2-fer ready areas. Nov 8 2026: only run 2-fers where BOTH ownership AND management data exist for the ownership_step. Nov 16 2026 (KPC owner, 2026-11-16): world (W-*) opened. Since the Nov 8 gate was written, the Nov 9 rule takes a park's owner from its own record or its agency name, the Nov 10 rule counts two official agency outlines as government or public land (a blank owner is no hold), and the POTA sub-park rule removed the same-agency block, so ownership and management no longer need their own data source for the finder to work. World rows are club room only (private store runs); a pair with no owner on its records is shown as 'not sure', never dropped. Not on this list = skip with a clear log. Edit this file (and bump key-rules-version.json 'fers') to change an area.

ownership.source: the park's own records and agency name (Nov 9 rule); official agency outlines count as government or public land (Nov 10 rule)
fields: the national layer owner or authority field, where the layer has one

management.source: the managing agency named on the park's own record or in its name
fields: the national layer authority or manager field, where the layer has one
